name: cover_m96_k1_1_75
description: Disjoint k1 branch cover for the affine-ladder m=96 reduced search. Each task fixes exactly one first block parameter k1; the search engine recursively enumerates all downstream choices allowed by the model.
requires_lemmas: Every m=96 cycle in the reduced Hercher/Simons-de Weger model satisfies 1 <= k1 <= 75.
For fixed k1, affine_ladder_prefix.cpp recursively enumerates all legal downstream valuations under the stated caps and lower-bound stages.
The lower-bound stages and caps in make_case(96) are valid consequences of the imported m-cycle inequalities.
